The CNAMEs bring the one proxied alias of a direct apex with them, so the pass also reports that proxy_split here. Cut from sample/bundle.json by scripts/examples.ts.

SELECT n.obs_id, n.host, n.object_id, n.setting_path, n.refers_to_id AS server_name, e.value_redacted AS enabled, n.value_hash, n.observed_at
FROM observation n
JOIN observation e ON e.run_id = n.run_id AND e.object_id = n.object_id AND e.setting_path LIKE '%.enabled' AND substr(e.setting_path, 1, length(e.setting_path) - 8) = substr(n.setting_path, 1, instr(n.setting_path, '.server_name[') - 1)
WHERE n.tenant_id = 'client-1' AND n.run_id = 'run-15638d43819ba756' AND n.refers_to_type = 'dns_name' AND n.setting_path LIKE '%.server_name[%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dns_record d WHERE d.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND d.run_id = 'run-f9470e2f5f175899' AND d.name = n.refers_to_id)
  AND (e.value_redacted = '1' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation n2 JOIN observation e2 ON e2.run_id = n2.run_id AND e2.object_id = n2.object_id AND e2.setting_path LIKE '%.enabled' AND substr(e2.setting_path, 1, length(e2.setting_path) - 8) = substr(n2.setting_path, 1, instr(n2.setting_path, '.server_name[') - 1)
    WHERE n2.run_id = n.run_id AND n2.refers_to_type = 'dns_name' AND n2.refers_to_id = n.refers_to_id AND n2.setting_path LIKE '%.server_name[%' AND e2.value_redacted = '1'))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dns_record w JOIN observation z ON z.setting_path LIKE '%.zone' AND substr(w.name, 3) = z.value_redacted
    WHERE w.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND w.run_id = 'run-f9470e2f5f175899' AND w.name LIKE '*.%'
    AND z.run_id = n.run_id AND z.object_id = n.object_id AND substr(z.setting_path, 1, length(z.setting_path) - 5) = n.setting_path)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation m WHERE m.run_id = n.run_id AND m.object_id = n.object_id AND m.refers_to_type = 'dns_name' AND m.refers_to_id = n.refers_to_id AND m.setting_path < n.setting_path)
ORDER BY n.host, n.object_id, n.refers_to_id, n.setting_path
